title: Signs of shock

source.name: MedlinePlus: Shock — U.S. National Library of Medicine

steps: Call or radio for help now.
Check that the person is breathing. Be ready to start CPR if they stop.
Have the person lie down on their back.
If there is no head, neck, back or leg injury, raise the feet about twelve inches.
Keep the person warm with a blanket or extra layers, including underneath them.
Do not give anything to eat or drink.
If they vomit, turn them onto their side, keeping the spine in line if injury is suspected.
Recheck breathing and responsiveness every few minutes.
